Which statement about the polymer PET is correct?
A
It can be broken down into its monomers and re-polymerised.
B
It is an addition polymer.
C
It is a polyamide.
D
It is made from amino acid monomers.

options.label: A
options.text: It can be broken down into its monomers and re-polymerised.

options.label: D
options.text: It is made from amino acid monomers.
